data.one_liner: Creates googleapis_auth AuthClient from GoogleSignIn credentials.
data.what_it_does: Provides an extension method that converts a GoogleSignIn authorization into a googleapis_auth AuthClient. The client can be used with googleapis package APIs to make authenticated calls.
use_when: You need to call Google APIs (e.g., People API) after a user signs in with Google Sign‑In.
You want to avoid manually handling OAuth token exchange and refresh logic.
avoid_when: You only need basic Google Sign‑In without accessing other Google APIs.
You prefer a custom OAuth flow or another authentication provider.
strengths: Bridges two official Flutter packages seamlessly.
Handles token refresh automatically via googleapis_auth.
Works on all supported platforms (android, ios, web, macos).
weaknesses: Requires the newer GoogleSignInClientAuthorization flow (breaking change in 3.0.0).
Limited to Google APIs; not a general OAuth solution.
